question: What foundational role does the mātṛkā hold in relation to all knowledges and mantras?
premises: Her motherhood extends to all knowledges.
Her motherhood extends to all mantras individually.
inference: The mātṛkā is the mother of all knowledges and of each mantra separately.
plain_english: She is the mother of all knowledges and of all mantras, each one separately.
